notes.title: Update v0.31.11 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31.11[/h1]

[u]Tiesday, September 19, 2017[/u]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added [b]permadeath protection[/b] as a passive item [i]Auto-Warp[/i] that is equipped by default on all ships.
[list]
[*]While the [i]Auto-Warp[/i] is equipped, any fatal damage will warp you back to the Motherbase instead.[/*]
[*]The [i]Auto-Warp[/i] prevents you from equipping a passive item, it gives [b]-25% to Sector Points & Credits during sector conquest[/b], and [b]prevents you from warping to T5 or T6 systems[/b].[/*]
[*]Unequipping the [i]Auto-Warp[/i] destroys it permanently for this ship.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]10 new music tracks![/*]
[*]New ships are now built with a [b]random skin out of the 3 basic skins[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[h1]SMALL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added an option (enabled by default) to [b]lock the mouse cursor to the game window[/b].[/*]
[*]Display [I][b]MAINTENANCE IN PROGRESS[/b][/i] instead of [i][b]RESTRICTED TO ADMINS[/b][/i] when trying to connect to the server during maintenance.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rounding all Credit gains up, so you always get at least 1 Credit for conquering a zone.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the save issue that affected some ships since previous version.[/*]
[*]Removed the confirmation message when quitting by Alt+F4 or clicking the red [x], since it caused the network library to disconnect.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.31.10 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31.10[/h1]

[u]Friday, September 15, 2017[/u]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a setting to [b]make the mouse cursor bigger[/b] (4 different sizes).[/*]
[*]Added a facultative key binding to [b]open/close all Warehouses at once[/b].[/*]
[*]The name of drops that are reserved for other players is now darkened to differentiate them better in a big pile of loot.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]SMALL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a confirmation window when quitting the game.[/*]
[*]The [i]Skin Shop[/i] is no longer opened automatically after building a new ship.[/*]
[*]Do not display a conquest time estimate during the first 10% of the Conquest.[/*]
[*]The ladder reward tooltip is now scaled up for players playing in high resolutions.[/*]
[*]Made [i]Send to Warehouse[/i] and [i]Convert to DNA[/i] dropzones a bit more visible.[/*]
[*]Improved errors messages in many different situations when you cannot connect to the game.[/*]
[*]You can now cancel modal windows with the [i]Escape[/i] key.[/*]
[*]Made the description of some controls more explicit.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]The [i]+X% item drop[/i] stat is now applied properly.[/*]
[*]The [i]Energy recharge[/i] stat of all passive items ([i]Dedicator[/i], [i]Duocator[/i] and [i]Tricator[/i]) has been lowered at max level, to prevent some cases of infinite abilities.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the progress of unlocks sometimes getting reset without any reason.
[list]
[*]Note that there is still a visual bug that make it so progress seems to be lost in some situations, but selecting a new ship of the type required by the unlock will refresh the counter to the right value.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Fixed the close button for the redesigned [i]Galaxy Conquest[/i] window.[/*]
[*]Fixed the danger tooltip on the Greed bar.[/*]
[*]Fixed typos on the ladder tooltips.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.31.9 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31.9[/h1]

[u]Sunday, September 10, 2017[/u]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]The [u]Empire News Network[/u] is now the [b]Galaxy Conquest[/b] window:
[list]
[*]All 3 ladders are now displayed in the game: [b]Grind Ladder[/b], [b]Skill Ladder[/b] and [b]Gangs Ladder[/b].[/*]
[*]The estimated time until the conquest ends is now computed and displayed in the game and on [url=http://gangsofspace.com]gangsofspace.com[/url]![/*]
[*]A tooltip has been added to show the ladder rewards.
[list]
[*][u]Please note that the skill ladder still lacks its Skin reward, it will be added in an upcoming version.[/u][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Small tooltips have been added to indicate what each ladder is about, and how to get SP and CP.[/*]
[*]The progress tooltip when docking to the Motherbase has been reworked to be more readable.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]The [b]“Send to motherbase” and “Convert to DNA” drop zones have been moved far away[/b] so you don’t mistake one for another.
[list]
[*]You can now also add a [b]key binding[/b] to these actions.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Added tooltips:
[list]
[*]On the danger bar in the top right.[/*]
[*]On the warp button in the bottom right.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the [b]bonus SP for being top Gang in a sector[/b]:
[list]
[*]Before v0.31.8, the sector conquest notification had been indicating a bonus SP of 50% / 25% / 10%, but it was actually never given to players due to a bug.[/*]
[*]Since we didn’t want to disrupt the conquest of Galaxy Tertio Vaporis, we had disabled this bonus in the tooltip in v0.31.8.[/*]
[*]With the start of Galaxy Quadro Vaporis in v0.31.9, we now have fixed the issue and set the bonus SP to [b]30% / 20% / 10%[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Changed the [b]bonus CP for being top Gang in a system[/b] from 35% / 20% / 10% to [b]30% / 20% / 10%[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hangar ships can no longer be scrolled with the mousewheel when there is no scrollbar.[/*]
[*]The “Get more storage…” button no longer scrolls along with the warehouse buttons.[/*]
[*]Move the Gang window to the left when deploying the invite panel in a position where it would be normally hidden.[/*]
[*]Fixed incorrectly surviving with 1 structure in some situations.[/*]
[*]Fix showing the wrong level after closing & re-opening the inventory window.[/*]
[*]Switching equipment with the 1 ~ 5 keys now also works with the inventory closed.[/*]
[*]Fix Ctrl-clicking a ship item to send it to an open warehouse.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.31.8 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31.8[/h1]

[u]Thursday, September 7, 2017[/u]

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Significantly reduced the number of server lags.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reservation time for jettisoned items has been increased from 1s to 3s (to let you fix an erroneous jettison, without impacting trading convenience too much).[/*]
[/list]
[h1]SMALL FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Hide inaccessible maps in the Navigation window.[/*]
[*]Do not allow to rebind the left mouse button, in order to prevent unfortunate accidents.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Do not allow players to kill themselves by unequipping a [u]+x% max structure[/u] passive item when on low structure.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: End of second conquest + patch v0.31.5
notes.notes:
[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/a/a9570f63c70de07fca805ed590582f2d84de49cf.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/a/a9570f63c70de07fca805ed590582f2d84de49cf_1_690x281.png[/img][/url]

Congratulations all, [b]you have eliminated 15,000,000 Pirnats points in 7 days, 6 hours, 13 minutes and 30 seconds![/b]

[h1]OVER THE TOP[/h1]

Without further ado, let’s examine the top of the ladders:

[list]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/fr/ladder/secundo-vaporis/grind]TOP GRIND[/url], [b]Zed[/b] sets a new record with 576k SP. Congratulations![/*]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/fr/ladder/secundo-vaporis/skill]TOP SKILL[/url] we also find [b]Zed[/b]. It’s the proof of a great talent! With 27k SP/h, he will be quite the challenger to beat. Will [b]kragnir[/b], [b]Jhirin[/b] or [b]Brotspinne[/b], who also show promising results, manage to reach his level?[/*]
[*]The [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/fr/ladder/secundo-vaporis/gangs]TOP GANG[/url], has been swamped by [b]Meta[/b] who entered the competition and left no hope to the other Gangs. With 1,484,800 CP, they have annihilated almost 10% of the Pirnat forces all by themselves! Our previous champions [b]Esports[/b] drop to [i]#4[/i], while the [b]8-Bit Warriors[/b] show great promises for the future conquests![/*]
[/list]


[h1]SUMMARY[/h1]

We have seen a few cheaters emerge during this Conquest. It is unfortunate to have to spend our very limited time and efforts to prevent them ruining the gaming experience of the community. We want to use the opportunity to remind everyone that [b]third-party hacking tools and client modifications are against our Terms of Use, and punishable by account ban[/b]. If you have doubt about what’s allowed or not, you can write us privately on contact@gangsofspace.com and we’ll clarify the situation.

On a more positive note, thanks to the efforts of the [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord[/url] community, the work on the [url=https://wiki.gangsofspace.com][b]Gangs of Space wiki[/b][/url]. Come have a look, and maybe help the writing or translation efforts if you can!

And finally on the Steam side, we have reached [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504300/Gangs_of_Space/#app_reviews_hash][b]180 evaluations[/b][/url]. Your honest opinion is always appreciated, and can help other players to better understand [i]Gangs of Space[/i]!

[h1]PATCH 0.31.5[/h1]

Here are the main changes of the new version, along with the start of the new Conquest:

[list]
[*]Collected Credits and blue DNA strands have been re-designed visually to be more readable.[/*]
[*]Private messages have been re-enabled: use /w  [/*]
[*]Some balancing to the Astrolax class:
[list]
[*]The energy cost of [i]S-Link[/i] has been adjusted to the one of [i]Y-Link[/i].[/*]
[*][i]Structure Wave[/i] radius has been greatly increased.[/*]
[*]The [i]Stolers[/i] armaments now also provide a significant passive damage bonus.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*][i]Kamikazes Hunter[/i] spawns have been limited in T4 and T5 systems.[/*]
[*]Many bug fixes and various small improvements.[/*]
[/list]

For all gritty details, you can read the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/28]changelog[/url] on the forum.

[h1]SHARK INVESTOR PACK[/h1]

“End of Conquest” means “dividends time” for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url] owners!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

The Imperial Bank has computed the total cost of the conquest of [i]Secundo Vaporis Galaxy[/i], and determined that [b]each Share will receive a dividend of 369 Credits[/b], meaning 18,450 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Shark Investor Pack. Thank you for financing our glorious Conquests!

Also note that the history of your dividends is now visible on your account management page on this very website!

[h1]SOUVENIR[/h1]

A few shots of the last moments in [i]Secundo Vaporis Galaxy[/i]. See you in [i]Tertio Vaporis[/i]!


[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/b/bcb6dab6d695ac088950a476212043e4ed71acf2.jpg][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/b/bcb6dab6d695ac088950a476212043e4ed71acf2_1_690x628.jpg[/img][/url]

With 1,484,800 CP, they have annihilated almost 10% of the Pirnat forces all by themselves! Our previous champions [b]Esports[/b] drop to [i]#4[/i], while the [b]8-Bit Warriors[/b] show great promises for the future conquests![/*]

If you have doubt about what’s allowed or not, you can write us privately on contact@gangsofspace.com and we’ll clarify the situation.

On a more positive note, thanks to the efforts of the [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord[/url] community, the work on the [url=https://wiki.gangsofspace.com][b]Gangs of Space wiki[/b][/url]. Come have a look, and maybe help the writing or translation efforts if you can!

[h1]PATCH 0.31.5[/h1]

Here are the main changes of the new version, along with the start of the new Conquest:

[list]
[*]Collected Credits and blue DNA strands have been re-designed visually to be more readable.[/*]
[*]Private messages have been re-enabled: use /w  [/*]
[*]Some balancing to the Astrolax class:
[list]
[*]The energy cost of [i]S-Link[/i] has been adjusted to the one of [i]Y-Link[/i].[/*]
[*][i]Structure Wave[/i] radius has been greatly increased.[/*]
[*]The [i]Stolers[/i] armaments now also provide a significant passive damage bonus.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*][i]Kamikazes Hunter[/i] spawns have been limited in T4 and T5 systems.[/*]
[*]Many bug fixes and various small improvements.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]SHARK INVESTOR PACK[/h1]

“End of Conquest” means “dividends time” for [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url] owners!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

The Imperial Bank has computed the total cost of the conquest of [i]Secundo Vaporis Galaxy[/i], and determined that [b]each Share will receive a dividend of 369 Credits[/b], meaning 18,450 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Shark Investor Pack. Thank you for financing our glorious Conquests!

Also note that the history of your dividends is now visible on your account management page on this very website!

notes.title: End of the first conquest & patch v0.31.4
notes.notes:
Congratulations to all players and all Gangs: [b]you conquered the Primor Vaporis Galaxy in 8 days, 7 hours, 36 minutes and 28 seconds![/b]

[h1]OVER THE TOP[/h1]

Let’s have a look at the final ladders:

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/697df3950de60ac3bdd5bc2d907007a0d2b09cc2.png][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/697df3950de60ac3bdd5bc2d907007a0d2b09cc2_1_690x287.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/grind]TOP GRIND[/url], we have a new Commander imposing his style: [b]Touch Me[/b] wins by a fair margin his title and his champion skin, with over 400,000 SP. Congratulations![/*]
[*]On the [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/gangs]TOP GANG[/url] ! [b]Esports[/b] get their first victory thank to a flawless teamwork. We say on the game Discord channel that this ladder was very fierce, and not only for the top 10 spots! Congratulations to everyone![/*]
[*]And finally, for the new [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/en/ladder/primor-vaporis/skill]TOP SKILL[/url], [b]Roix[/b] shows us that experience acquired over years of alpha versions still make him the top dog. With [b]a peak of over 25k SP/h[/b], he dominates the ladder by far.[/*]
[/list]


With this first conquest on Steam Early Access, many new players have joined the ranks of the Empire and are learning all the mechanics of the game very fast. Next Galaxy should turn out very competitive indeed!

[h1]STATE OF THE GAME[/h1]

It is for us a great emotion to see the servers so full of players all the time, for the first time of the existence of the game. From the bottom of our heart: THANK YOU! We’ve spent years working on this game, and seeing so many people enjoying it for real is giving us the energy to move forward with the game.


Speaking of moving forward, some words about our next steps.We are globally satisfied with the state of the game, but we have seen [b]how hard it is for many players to understand the game[/b], or some parts of it. We plan on putting a lot of efforts over the next weeks to improve the situation, and have already started to work on a FAQ here: [url=https://www.gangsofspace.com/faq]https://www.gangsofspace.com/faq[/url]


The [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord community[/url]  has also started to work on a wiki to give more details, with specific numbers for every aspect of the game. Join them if you want to help the effort!


Over the past week, we have been having [b]between 150 and 250 players online almost all the time[/b]. This makes the universe alive, with always something to do. We had to fix a few things on the server side to handle the load. This invisible effort continues every day, and will probably continue all over the duration of the Early Access. Thank you for bearing with the small bugs and slowdowns, and be assured that fixing that is always at high priority on our list.


On the Steam side, we’ve passed [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/504300/Gangs_of_Space/#app_reviews_hash][b]100+ evaluations[/b][/url] with [b]81% positive[/b]. Don’t hesitate to add your voice to the crowd, that’s how more players will know about [u]Gangs of Space[/u]!

[h1]PATCH 0.31.4[/h1]

We have deployed [b]v0.31.4[/b] along with the opening of the new Galaxy.


The main visible change of this version is the complete overhaul of Credit gains. We changed the Conquest rewards in v0.30 a few months ago, and we were a bit too conservative on the gains of the new system. Now that we have more data to back up our design, [b]we have increased the Credit rewards of conquest quite significantly[/b], especially in lower Tiers.


We also added a feature where [b]every time you unlock a new ship, you will gain the amount Credits necessary to build this ship[/b]. For example, when you unlock the [u]Gemeter DX[/u], you will now receive 10,000 Credits. [b]We have applied this retroactively to all already unlocked ships.[/b]


For more details, you can read the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/27]complete changelog[/url].

[h1]SHARE DIVIDENDS[/h1]

If you bought a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/]Shark Investor Pack[/url], now is the time to figure out how many Credits your Shares have produced!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

After a complex calculation by the Imperial Bank, we have determined that every Share will receive a dividend of 202 Credits.


But as a celebration of the first Conquest, and because the lowered Credit gains have impacted the amount of total Credits spent, we have decided to double this amount. You have thus received 404 Credits per Share, which means [b]20,200 Credits for a 50 Share Investor Pack[/b].


Stay tuned for the next Conquest. Hopefully, with the increase of Credit gains brought by the new patch, dividends might rise even further!

[h1]A MMO IS A COMMUNITY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE[/h1]

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/JwTKNu5]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/]forum[/url]. We are answering all your questions, and listening to all your suggestions for the future of the game!

[h1]SOUVENIR[/h1]

A last memory of [u]Primor Vaporis[/u] before leaving for a new adventure:

[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/a8abbb9425140679c4e89020a4d9f403a8fa0826.jpg][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/a8abbb9425140679c4e89020a4d9f403a8fa0826_1_690x388.jpg[/img][/url]


[url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/1X/109e01d4c3fd9cc60eb097cccc030ec28e10fd31.jpg][img]https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/109e01d4c3fd9cc60eb097cccc030ec28e10fd31_1_690x388.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update v0.31.4 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31.4[/h1]

[u]Saturday, August 19, 2017[/u]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Credit rewards for conquest[/b] have been significantly increased for all Tiers.[/*]
[*]We are now giving [b]Credit rewards when unlocking new ships[/b], of the build cost of the ship. This will ensure you can always immediatly build a ship you just unlocked.
[list]
[*]For example, unlocking the [u]Gemeter SX[/u] will give you 1,000 Credits, and unlocking the [u]Gemeter DX[/u] will give you 10,000 Credits.[/*]
[*]
[b]NOTE:[/b] These rewards will be applied retroactively to already unlocked ships.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Overall quality for rare drops has been increased in T6 systems.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a serious bug where Credits were not given when purchasing Packs. This affected very few customers, and we are in the process of fixing their accounts and contacting them individually.[/*]
[*]Items are no longer destructible after 10s, but properly after 30s.[/*]
[*]Disabled the foreword from the developers on first launch, which seemed to cause blocking issues to some players.[/*]
[*]Removed the ability to bind keys [u]Hide all interfaces[/u] and [u]Hide interfaces partially[/u], which caused issues when bound to left click for example.[/*]
[*]Fixed the LinkSys abilities being properly removed from their target when the emitting Astrolax dies.[/*]
[*]Fixed the computation of remaining SP on the sector description and sector tooltip. The number displayed was only approximately correct, now it should be exact.[/*]
[*](Hopefully) fixed the issue of the navigation UI getting cluttered with Conquered systems.[/*]
[*]Fixed a typo in the description of [u]RaimBlock[/u].[/*]
[/list]

All the latest patch notes [url=https://forum.gangsofspace.com/t/changelog/198/27]are readable in this thread[/url].

[h1]Version 0.31.1[/h1]

[u]Sunday, August 13, 2017[/u]

[h1]SMALL CHANGES[/h1]

[list][*]Added the [b]Sellout Panel[/b] to remind you of all the magnificent benefits of purchasing one of the [u]Gangs of Space[/u] supporter packs. notes.title: Update v0.31 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.31[/h1]

[u]Thursday, August 10, 2017[/u]

[h1]MAIN FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*][u]Gangs of Space[/u] is now available on [b]Steam Early Access[/b]!
[list]
[*]With a brand new title screen.[/*]
[*]3 new skins & titles that can be purchased in Early Access Packs.[/*]
[*]Foreword from the developers on first launch of the client.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Changes to the [b]conquest system[/b]:
[list]
[*]Conquering each zone now gives [b]Credits[/b] instead of DNA (or Greed).[/*]
[*]Conquest is now the sole source of Credits (no more Credits on Greed level up or ship destruction).[/*]
[*]Greed level now affects [b]both conquest speed AND the number of Credits[/b] & Sector Points earned.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]New [b]tutorial system[/b] that forces you to do a few specific actions when you start the game.
[list]
[*]These tutorial tooltips can be completely disabled in the Settings.[/*]
[*][b]Tips[/b] about the game are also shown on warp screens.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[*]Redesigned [b]Gang interface[/b]:
[list]
[*]Gangs can be [b]created from within the game[/b].[/*]
[*]Gang members now have [b]ranks[/b]: Owner, Admin, or Member.[/*]
[*]New [b]invitation UI[/b] (both for inviter & invitee).[/*]
[*]Owner can now leave their Gang, and ownership will be automatically transfered to next highest ranking member.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Player resistance are now capped to 75% (down from 90%).[/*]
[*]When you loose a Greed level, you do not start at the beginning of the previous level, but at the end of it. The Greed depleting rate has been slightly increased. Overall, higher Greed levels are easier to obtain & sustain.[/*]
[*]Boss no longer spawn before T4.[/*]
[*]Common items drop less in high tier systems.[/*]
[*]The leveling from level 1 to level 10 is now smoother.[/*]
[*]Enemy group compositions have been re-balanced.[/*]
[*]Small zones now give a bit more Credits and Sector Points.[/*]
[*]Conquest scores now expire faster if you leave a Sector untouched (3 minutes, down from 1 hour).[/*]
[/list]
[h1]SMALL CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Warehouses can be renamed and re-ordered.[/*]
[*]Added an alternative basic skin for Gemeters and Astrolaxes, available to everyone.[/*]
[*]Skins no longer cost Credits to apply to your ships.[/*]
[*]Conquered maps now close after 5 minutes (down from 10 minutes).[/*]
[*]The Objective Tracker is now a little more readable.[/*]
[*]Gates are now oriented properly in the Motherbase.[/*]
[*]Tooltips are much more readable across the board.[/*]
[*]Multiple tiers can be deployed at the same time in the Navigation window.[/*]
[*]When you reach a certain power level, the game will suggest T4 (normal), T5 (hard) and T6 (very hard) systems instead of just suggesting T4.[/*]
[*]Added trophy titles from the previous conquests.[/*]
[*]Updated the player overlay to make the name & bars more readable.[/*]
[*]Updated the enemy gauge to make it more readable.[/*]
[*]Neutral Sectors (= conquered by the Empire) are now shown in blue, the same as Sectors conquered by a Gang.[/*]
[*]You can see other players’ item hauls.[/*]
[*]You can no longer move, jettison or destroy items during the Warp countdown.[/*]
[*]Support for multiple Motherbases (in case of high server load).[/*]
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the client freezing when joining some broken systems.[/*]
[*]Removed hidden Greed leveling in T1~T3 maps.[/*]
[*]Fixed the position where popup list open (ex: ship selector in Achievement Codex, resolution list in Settings…).[/*]
[*]Fixed many broken sprites all over the UI.[/*]
[*]Boss lifebars no longer block on the first bar.[/*]
[*]Player & enemies overlays stay in proper position when changing resolution.[/*]
[*]The client log should no longer grow to multiple GB.[/*]
[*]Fixed a slight jerkiness on the damage numbers’ movement.[/*]
[*]Conquest gauge no longer overlaps with the leveling choice window.[/*]
[*]Typing 1~5 in chat will no longer swap items when chatting with the Ship window open.[/*]
[*]Prevent multiple cases of disconnect with the message “ITEM OPERATION CANCELLED”.[/*]
[/list]
